title: Basaa Tech Term
description: A curated Basaa rendering of a technical / digital / career-domain term. Many such terms have no traditional Basaa equivalent, so this schema supports coinage, loanword, and descriptive strategies. Maps to the basaa_tech_terms table.

id.description: Stable unique id (UUID/slug). Assigned at load time if absent.

term_source.description: The source-language technical term being rendered (e.g. 'database', 'login').

basaa_term.description: Proposed/approved Basaa term in canonical orthography, tone preserved.

strategy.description: How the Basaa term was derived.

definition_basaa.description: Short explanation of the term in Basaa.

definition_gloss.description: Short explanation in the source language for reviewers.

source_id.description: Registry id of the source asset, if derived from one (matches BASAA_SOURCES[].id).
